  % Caption note: Arms: control = Dolmino only, token-matched to the iso-token arm; iso-token = the same 10.0M-token Python-4 corpus (four copies) at every scale; prop-token = a Python-4 dose proportional to parameter count, anchored at the whole 49.5M-token corpus for the 110B model (GLM run names: experimental = iso-token, experimental_50m = prop-token). Token counts are Gemma-3-tokenizer counts, the campaign's counting basis; the GLM step counts divide its own tokenizer's count of the same mixes (77.1M / 373.7M / 74.0M tokens) by 262,144. The four Python-4 copies are shuffled into an equal-token stream of Dolmino.
  % Caption note: Base models are the pretrained (non-instruct) checkpoints; GLM-4.5-Air-Base is a mixture-of-experts model with 12B active parameters. All runs used H200 GPUs: 4 for Gemma-4 12B, 8 for Gemma-4 31B and for GLM-4.5-Air. Midtraining supervises every token (completion format). The Dolci SFT uses the train split of allenai/Dolci-Instruct-SFT after a strict user/assistant alternation filter (1,923,659 of 2,152,112 rows), packed to 8,192 tokens; 48 steps x 2,097,152 tokens = 100.7M tokens, the step cap binding inside one nominal epoch.
  % Caption note: Chat-vector grafts exist for all three scales; RL was run only on the Gemma-4 31B prop-token graft. The graft takes tokenizer, config and chat template from the -it model.
